reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: North Carolina
    Focus year: 2021
    Question: "Are eviction cases first heard in high court?"
*/

/* =========================
   Scenario Facts (Question)
   ========================= */

jurisdiction(north_carolina).
focus_year(2021).

/* We model an "eviction case" as a North Carolina summary ejectment action.
   The question is about where such a case is FIRST heard.
*/
scenario_case(case1).

case_type(case1, summary_ejectment).

/* Facts chosen to reflect the typical NC eviction pathway: summary ejectment
   brought as a small claim and assigned to a magistrate. */
filed_as_small_claim(case1, yes).
amount_in_controversy(case1, 5000).                 % <= $10,000
case_principal_reliefs(case1, [summary_ejectment]).  % principal relief is summary ejectment
plaintiff_requested_assignment_to_magistrate(case1, yes).
assigned_to_magistrate(case1, yes).

/* Not a title-dispute transfer scenario */
defendant_denies_plaintiff_title_in_written_answer(case1, no).

/* Not an appeal posture in the scenario */
appealed_from_magistrate_to_district(case1, no).

/* scenario_statement/0 succeeds when the encoded factual statement holds. */
scenario_statement :-
    jurisdiction(north_carolina),
    focus_year(2021),
    scenario_case(Case),
    case_type(Case, summary_ejectment),
    filed_as_small_claim(Case, yes),
    amount_in_controversy(Case, Amt),
    Amt =< 10000,
    case_principal_reliefs(Case, Reliefs),
    Reliefs \= [],
    plaintiff_requested_assignment_to_magistrate(Case, yes),
    assigned_to_magistrate(Case, yes),
    defendant_denies_plaintiff_title_in_written_answer(Case, no),
    appealed_from_magistrate_to_district(Case, no).

/* =========================
   Basic List Utilities
   ========================= */

all_items_satisfy_predicate(_, []) :- !.
all_items_satisfy_predicate(Pred, [H|T]) :-
    call(Pred, H),
    all_items_satisfy_predicate(Pred, T),
    !.

/* =========================
   Statute Translations
   ========================= */

/* --- NC Gen Stat  7A-210 (2021): Small claim action defined. --- */

/* Allowed principal relief types in a "small claim action". */
statute_7a210_allowed_principal_relief(monetary) :- !.
statute_7a210_allowed_principal_relief(recovery_specific_personal_property) :- !.
statute_7a210_allowed_principal_relief(summary_ejectment) :- !.

/* A case qualifies as a "small claim action" if:
   (1) amount in controversy <= 10,000
   (2) only principal relief prayed is among allowed types (or combination)
   (3) plaintiff requested assignment to a magistrate
*/
statute_7a210_small_claim_action(Case) :-
    amount_in_controversy(Case, Amt),
    Amt =< 10000,
    case_principal_reliefs(Case, Reliefs),
    Reliefs \= [],
    all_items_satisfy_predicate(statute_7a210_allowed_principal_relief, Reliefs),
    plaintiff_requested_assignment_to_magistrate(Case, yes),
    !.
statute_7a210_small_claim_action(_) :-
    fail.

/* --- NC Gen Stat  7A-222 (2021): Trial of a small claim before a magistrate. --- */

/* Encodes the general rule: trial of a small claim action is before a magistrate. */
statute_7a222_trial_of_small_claim_before_magistrate(Case) :-
    statute_7a210_small_claim_action(Case),
    assigned_to_magistrate(Case, yes),
    !.
statute_7a222_trial_of_small_claim_before_magistrate(_) :-
    fail.

/* --- NC Gen Stat  7A-223(a) (2021): Summary ejectment small claim assigned to magistrate,
       but if defendant denies title in written answer -> placed on district court civil issue docket. --- */

statute_7a223_title_denial_transfers_to_district_judge(Case) :-
    case_type(Case, summary_ejectment),
    statute_7a210_small_claim_action(Case),
    assigned_to_magistrate(Case, yes),
    defendant_denies_plaintiff_title_in_written_answer(Case, yes),
    !.
statute_7a223_title_denial_transfers_to_district_judge(_) :-
    fail.

/* --- NC Gen Stat  42-68 (2021): Expedited proceedings.
       - If filed as small claim -> expedited small-claims process applies.
       - If filed initially in district court OR appealed from magistrate to district court -> district-court procedure applies.
*/

statute_42_68_proceeding_in_small_claims_track(Case) :-
    filed_as_small_claim(Case, yes),
    !.
statute_42_68_proceeding_in_small_claims_track(_) :-
    fail.

statute_42_68_proceeding_in_district_court_track(Case) :-
    ( filed_as_small_claim(Case, no)
    ; appealed_from_magistrate_to_district(Case, yes)
    ),
    !.
statute_42_68_proceeding_in_district_court_track(_) :-
    fail.

/* --- NC Gen Stat  7A-305 (2021): Costs in civil actions (partial, relevant encoding). --- */

statute_7a305_facilities_fee(magistrate, 12) :- !.
statute_7a305_facilities_fee(district_court, 16) :- !.
statute_7a305_facilities_fee(superior_court, 16) :- !.

statute_7a305_general_court_of_justice_fee(assigned_to_magistrate, 80) :- !.
statute_7a305_general_court_of_justice_fee(district_court, 130) :- !.
statute_7a305_general_court_of_justice_fee(superior_court, 180) :- !.

/* =========================
   Derived Legal Reasoning
   ========================= */

/* We treat "high court" in this question as North Carolina Superior Court. */
high_court_forum(superior_court) :- !.
high_court_forum(_) :- fail.

/* Determine the forum of the FIRST hearing/trial based on the encoded statutes. */
first_hearing_forum(Case, district_court) :-
    /* If title is denied by written answer, small-claim summary ejectment is moved to district court */
    statute_7a223_title_denial_transfers_to_district_judge(Case),
    !.
first_hearing_forum(Case, district_court) :-
    /* If filed initially in district court (not small claim), or is in district court on appeal */
    statute_42_68_proceeding_in_district_court_track(Case),
    !.
first_hearing_forum(Case, magistrate) :-
    /* Otherwise, a qualifying small claim assigned to magistrate is tried before the magistrate */
    statute_7a222_trial_of_small_claim_before_magistrate(Case),
    !.
first_hearing_forum(_, unknown) :-
    /* Catch-all to keep determinism even if facts are incomplete */
    !.

/* =========================
   Question Answering
   ========================= */

housing_answer(Result) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_case(Case),
    first_hearing_forum(Case, Forum),
    ( high_court_forum(Forum)
    -> Result = yes
    ;  Result = no
    ),
    !.

/* =========================
   Main Entrypoint
   ========================= */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Are eviction cases first heard in high court?
